lines.zh: 我在袋子里数过你的脚步声。
lines.en: I counted your footsteps from inside the pouch.
The moment the pouch loosens, I poke my head out.

lines.zh: 小短腿跟不上你的大步。
lines.en: My short legs can't keep up with your stride.
The canvas rubs my ears until they itch.

lines.zh: 我走在你的影子里，比较安全。
lines.en: I walk in your shadow; it feels safer there.

lines.zh: 被关久了，走路有点发飘。
lines.en: Caged so long, my steps still feel unsteady.

lines.zh: 每走十步，我就呜咽一声。
lines.en: Every ten steps, I let out a small whine.

lines.zh: 我怕踩到草叶下的虫子。
lines.en: I fear stepping on the bugs beneath the grass.
This road smells like the inside of a pouch.
Not so fast, my legs are trembling.
I hug the side of your boot as we walk.
The light ahead is bright; I squint.

lines.zh: 我想闻闻那丛陌生的草。
lines.en: I want to sniff that unfamiliar clump of grass.

lines.zh: 走两步就回头，怕被丢下。
lines.en: Two steps, one glance back, afraid of being left.

lines.zh: 我闻着草根，一路低头走。
lines.en: I walk with my head down, sniffing roots.

lines.zh: 你慢一点，我小跑才跟上。
lines.en: Slow down; I have to trot to keep up.
Whimper, whimper. I'm fine, really.

lines.zh: 我把自己缩成一个毛团。
lines.en: I curl myself into a small fuzzy ball.
One ear twitches; I'm listening for you.

lines.zh: 袋口那道缝，我记了很久。
lines.en: I remember that slit of light for a long time.
The whining just won't stop on its own.
I lick a paw, then lick my nose.

lines.zh: 角落里比较像袋子里面。
lines.en: A corner feels more like the inside of a bag.
I count the water dripping from the ceiling.
When someone comes, I pretend to sleep.
This tuft of fur is tangled again.

lines.zh: 安静下来，我又想起袋子。
lines.en: In the quiet, I remember the pouch again.
I press my nose against the edge of your hand.
That little sound in my throat won't stay down.

lines.zh: 我打了一个很小很小的哈欠。
lines.en: I give a very, very small yawn.
I whine once and lean my head over.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我的毛全竖起来。
lines.en: One gust and all my fur stands up.
Are you my second pouch, then?
I look up at you with wet eyes.
Will you set me down this time?
I've memorized the smell of you.
Don't reach out suddenly; I'll cry out.

lines.zh: 你弯腰的时候，我好想蹭你。
lines.en: When you bend down, I want to nuzzle you.
I whimper and nudge against your hand.
Your shadow covers me, and it is warm.

lines.zh: 我小声呜咽，是在打招呼。
lines.en: My soft whimper is how I say hello.

lines.zh: 你手上没有袋子，我放心了。
lines.en: Your hands hold no pouch, so I relax.
I can see your eyelashes from here.
What are you smiling at? I did nothing wrong.
Whine! I did nothing at all.

lines.zh: 我整只缩在你脚边发抖。
lines.en: I shrink against your feet, trembling all over.

lines.zh: 这一下比袋子晃得还狠。
lines.en: That hurt more than a shaking pouch.
My ears are pinned flat against my head.
Stop hitting me; I'll be good.
My whimpering breaks every word apart.
The smell of blood frightens me more.
I back away and hit the wall.
You hit so hard, and it hurts.
I cover my head and wait for you to stop.
Is this edible? Let me sniff it first.

lines.zh: 袋子里的干粮没这么香。
lines.en: The pouch rations never smelled this good.
I came out of that pet pouch hungry too.

lines.zh: 我在袋子里从没吃饱过。
lines.en: Inside the pouch, I was never full.
The pouch mouth is too high for me.

lines.zh: 我呜咽，是因为太想吃了。
lines.en: I whimper because I want it so much.
I will roll over for a taste.

lines.zh: 闻起来像篷车上的甜味。
lines.en: It smells sweet, like the caravan wagons.

lines.zh: 吃之前，我先看看你的脸色。
lines.en: Before eating, I check your face for permission.
My little claws are already reaching out.
Don't tease me; I really will cry.
For this bite, I'll remember you forever.

lines.zh: 我吃得慢，怕吃完就没了。
lines.en: I eat slowly, afraid it ends too soon.
There's still a taste on your fingers.

lines.zh: 你剥开果皮，声音我都听见。
lines.en: I hear every sound as you peel the fruit.

lines.zh: 我先舔一口，再决定吃不吃。
lines.en: Let me lick it once, then I will decide.
Sorry! I didn't mean to bump you.

lines.zh: 这一撞把我滚进了草丛。
lines.en: The bump rolls me over into the grass.
Don't step on me; I'm very small.
I shrink aside to let you pass.
Ouch, my knee hit the stone.
Why do you walk so heavily?
I back away, straight into the grass.

lines.zh: 我整圈毛都立着，像被踩过。
lines.en: My fur stands on end, as if trampled.
The pouch hit walls with that same sound.
I cling to your ankle and won't let go.

lines.zh: 我给她理了理耳后的毛。
lines.en: I smoothed the fur behind her ears.

lines.zh: 两只小东西挤在一个袋口。
lines.en: Two small creatures crowded at one pouch mouth.

lines.zh: 我呜咽，她轻轻回了一声。
lines.en: I whine, and she answers softly.

lines.zh: 我们靠得很近，谁都不动。
lines.en: We sit close and neither of us moves.
I push the best grass over to her.
Her breathing is slower than mine.
Even outside a pouch, we can nest.

lines.zh: 我小心地碰了碰她的鼻子。
lines.en: I carefully touch my nose to hers.
No more whimpering alone, either of us.
While she sleeps, I keep watch.

lines.zh: 亮石子藏进我的小袋子。
lines.en: The shiny pebble goes into my little pouch.
Can this go in the pouch?
I carry it in my mouth and run to you.
It's for you; don't refuse it.

lines.zh: 我藏了一颗，明天再给你。
lines.en: I hid one; I'll give it tomorrow.
This one smells like old cloth.
I tuck it under my belly.

lines.zh: 这石子亮，我要塞进袋子里。
lines.en: This pebble is shiny — it goes in my bag.
My collection gained one more piece.
The stone hurts my teeth, but I won't drop it.

lines.zh: 我从袋子里探头，只会呜咽。
lines.en: I peek from the pouch and only whimper.
I duck low and curl into a ball.
That's not food; those are teeth.
A warning rises from my throat.
Stay back; I will bite.
I stare at it, ears pinned back.
The pouch taught me: hide first, cry later.

lines.zh: 它的影子比我的大太多。
lines.en: Its shadow is far bigger than mine.

lines.zh: 我钻到你靴子后面躲着。
lines.en: I duck behind your boot and hide there.
I count its steps: one, two.
I keep my eyes fixed that way.
I lower my body and creep sideways.
Every time it turns, I flinch.
My whimpering has gone quiet.
I'll breathe once it walks away.
My claws dig into the dirt.
Don't look at me; watch it.

lines.zh: 我记住它身上的味道了。
lines.en: I've memorized the smell it carries.
One more step closer and I run.
I press against your leg and freeze.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，又立刻松口。
lines.en: I bite once, then let go at once.

lines.zh: 这一下用尽了我的胆子。
lines.en: That strike used up all my courage.
Small teeth, sharp bite.
After the hit, I leap backward.
Don't push me; I don't want to bite.
I swipe once, and my paw goes numb.
Whine. That was my final warning.
I lunge, then squeeze my eyes shut.
I tore a hole in your sleeve.
When it's over, I hide behind you.

lines.zh: 袋口开了，光刺得我睁不开眼。
lines.en: The pouch opens, and the light blinds me.

lines.zh: 我又被放在陌生的地上。
lines.en: I'm set down on unfamiliar ground again.

lines.zh: 这里不是篷车，也不是袋子。
lines.en: This is neither the wagon nor the pouch.

lines.zh: 我先呜咽一声，试试有没有回应。
lines.en: I whimper once to see if anything answers.
I squeezed out through a seam of cloth.

lines.zh: 空气里有草和铁的味道。
lines.en: The air tastes of grass and iron.
I shake out every bit of my fur.

lines.zh: 有人把我拎起来又放下。
lines.en: Someone lifted me up and set me down.
New place; first I look for a corner.

lines.zh: 我还没弄明白发生了什么。
lines.en: I haven't worked out what just happened.
Fire singes my fur; the burnt smell stings.

lines.zh: 摔下来时，我连叫都忘了。
lines.en: Falling, I forgot even how to cry out.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻子，我拼命扑腾。
lines.en: Water fills my nose; I thrash wildly.
A boom throws me into the air.
That arrow pins me where I stand.

lines.zh: 紫色的光钻进毛里，发冷。
lines.en: Purple light seeps into my fur, cold.

lines.zh: 我饿得连呜咽都没力气。
lines.en: I'm too hungry to whimper anymore.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我满身毛立着。
lines.en: Lightning strikes; every hair stands up.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我一路往下掉。
lines.en: The ground vanishes; I keep falling down.
